high_level_description: The image is divided into two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a fashion show scene. A model is walking down a runway, showcasing a casual yet stylish outfit. The model is wearing a dark blue denim jacket over a white turtleneck sweater with a black and white patterned design. The lower part of the outfit consists of blue and white striped shorts, paired with white socks that have black stripes and black shoes. The model carries a brown leather bag slung over one shoulder. The audience on either side of the runway is seated, attentively watching the model.
